Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 149. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 25x ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Super Ghost Kamikaze
Attack
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (60 feet)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: 1 minute (concentration)
Type: Omni
The user spits out a number of identical ghost
versions of themselves up to or equal to half of their
proficiency bonus.
The Ghosts float harmlessly around you for the
duration. As an action you may fire a ghost at a target
within range, Roll an Omni Attack Roll dealing your
3d12 Ki Damage on a hit.
These ghosts count toward the count for the
“Ultimate Ghost Guardians” Technique.
